chunks: Muhammad ibn Isa, by his chain, from the Righteous Ones (peace be upon them) who said:

You should repeat this supplication on the night of the 23rd of Ramadan, prostrating, standing, and sitting, in every state, and throughout the whole month, whenever it is possible for you and whenever the time presents itself, saying after praising Allah, Blessed and Exalted, and sending blessings upon the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family):

O Allah, be for your guardian, so-and-so ibn so-and-so, during this hour and every hour, a guardian, a protector, a helper, a proof, a guide, an aid, and a witness, until You settle him in Your earth willingly and grant him enjoyment therein for a long time.

And you should say on the fourth night: O Splitter of the dawn, and Maker of the night as tranquility, and the sun and moon for calculation, O Mighty, O Knowledgeable, O Possessor of Favor and Grace, Strength and Power, Bounty and Bestowal, Kingdom and Honor, O Possessor of Majesty and Honor, O Allah, O Merciful, O Allah, O Solitary, O One, O Allah, O Manifest, O Hidden, O Living, O, there is no god but You, to You belong the Beautiful Names, the Lofty Examples, and the Greatness.

I ask You to send blessings upon Muhammad and his Family, and to make my name among the fortunate in this night, and my soul with the martyrs, and my good deeds in the Illiyyun, and my bad deeds forgiven, and to grant me certainty that touches my heart, and faith that removes doubt from me, and contentment with what You have apportioned for me, and give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and save us from the burning punishment, and grant me remembrance of You, gratitude to You, hope in You, return to You, repentance, and success in what You succeeded Muhammad and the Family of Muhammad (peace be upon them) in.

And you should say on the fifth night: O Maker of the night as clothing, and the day as livelihood, and the earth as an expanse, and the mountains as pegs, O Allah, O Conqueror, O Allah, O Compeller, O Allah, O Listener, O Allah, O Near, O Allah, O Answerer, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, to You belong the Beautiful Names, the Lofty Examples, the Greatness, and the Blessings.

I ask You to send blessings upon Muhammad and his Family, and to make my name among the fortunate in this night, and my soul with the martyrs, and my good deeds in the Illiyyun, and my bad deeds forgiven, and to grant me certainty that touches my heart, and faith that removes doubt from me, and contentment with what You have apportioned for me, and give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and save us from the burning punishment, and grant me remembrance of You, gratitude to You, hope in You, return to You, repentance, and success in what You succeeded Muhammad and the Family of Muhammad (peace be upon them) in.

And you should say on the sixth night: O Maker of the night and day as two signs, O He who erased the sign of the night and made the sign of the day visible, so that you may seek His bounty and pleasure, O Detailer of every thing with detail, O Generous, O Bestower, O Allah, O Benevolent, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, to You belong the Beautiful Names, the Lofty Examples, the Greatness, and the Blessings.

I ask You to send blessings upon Muhammad and his Family, and to make my name among the fortunate in this night, and my soul with the martyrs, and my good deeds in the Illiyyun, and my bad deeds forgiven, and to grant me certainty that touches my heart, and faith that removes doubt from me, and to please me with what You have apportioned for me, and give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and save us from the burning punishment, and grant me remembrance of You, gratitude to You, hope in You, return to You, repentance, and success in what You succeeded Muhammad and the Family of Muhammad (peace be upon them) in.

And you should say on the seventh night: O Extender of the shade, and if You willed, You would have made it stationary and made the sun a proof over it, then You gathered it to Yourself with an easy gathering, O Possessor of Generosity and Grace, Greatness and Blessings, there is no god but You, Knower of the unseen and the seen, the Merciful, the Compassionate, there is no god but You, O Holy, O Peace, O Secure, O Guardian, O Mighty, O Compeller, O Supreme, O Allah, O Creator, O Maker, O Fashioner, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, to You belong the Beautiful Names, the Lofty Examples, the Greatness, and the Blessings.

I ask You to send blessings upon Muhammad and his Family, and to make my name among the fortunate in this night, and my soul with the martyrs, and my good deeds in the Illiyyun, and my bad deeds forgiven, and to grant me certainty that touches my heart, and faith that removes doubt from me, and to please me with what You have apportioned for me, and give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and save us from the burning punishment, and grant me remembrance of You, gratitude to You, hope in You, return to You, repentance, and success in what You succeeded Muhammad and the Family of Muhammad (peace be upon them) in.

And you should say on the eighth night: O Treasurer of the night in the air, and Treasurer of the light in the sky, and Preventer of the sky from falling upon the earth except by His permission, and Withholder of them both from moving, O Knowledgeable, O Forgiver, O Eternal, O Allah, O Inheritor, O Resurrector of those in the graves, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, to You belong the Beautiful Names, the Lofty Examples, the Greatness, and the Blessings.

I ask You to send blessings upon Muhammad and his Family, and to make my name among the fortunate in this night, and my soul with the martyrs, and my good deeds in the Illiyyun, and my bad deeds forgiven, and to grant me certainty that touches my heart, and faith that removes doubt from me, and to please me with what You have apportioned for me, and give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and save us from the burning punishment, and grant me remembrance of You, gratitude to You, hope in You, return to You, repentance, and success in what You succeeded Muhammad and the Family of Muhammad (peace be upon them) in.

And you should say on the ninth night: O Roller of the night over the day, and Roller of the day over the night, O Knowledgeable, O Wise, O Allah, O Lord of Lords, and Master of Masters, there is no god but You, O Nearer to me than the jugular vein, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, to You belong the Beautiful Names, the Lofty Examples, the Greatness, and the Blessings.

I ask You to send blessings upon Muhammad and his Family, and to make my name among the fortunate in this night, and my soul with the martyrs, and my good deeds in the Illiyyun, and my bad deeds forgiven, and to grant me certainty that touches my heart, and faith that removes doubt from me, and to please me with what You have apportioned for me, and give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and save us from the burning punishment, and grant me remembrance of You, gratitude to You, hope in You, return to You, repentance, and success in what You succeeded Muhammad and the Family of Muhammad (peace be upon them) in.

And you should say on the tenth night: Praise is for Allah, there is no partner for Him, Praise is for Allah as befits the Nobility of His Face and the Honor of His Majesty, and as He is worthy of it, O Holy, O Light of Holiness, O Praiseworthy, O End of Glorification, O Merciful, O Doer of Mercy, O Knowledgeable, O Great, O Allah, O Subtle, O Majestic, O Allah, O Listener, O Seer, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, to You belong the Beautiful Names, the Lofty Examples, the Greatness, and the Blessings.

I ask You to send blessings upon Muhammad and his Family, and to make my name among the fortunate in this night, and my soul with the martyrs, and my good deeds in the Illiyyun, and my bad deeds forgiven, and to grant me certainty that touches my heart, and faith that removes doubt from me, and to please me with what You have apportioned for me, and give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and save us from the burning punishment, and grant me remembrance of You, gratitude to You, hope in You, return to You, repentance, and success in what You succeeded Muhammad and the Family of Muhammad (peace be upon them) in.

ai.seo_question: What is the supplication to recite on the nights of the last ten days of Ramadan according to Shia tradition?
ai.summary: This supplication, found in *Al-Kafi*, is a cornerstone of Shia devotion during the *Ishraq* (dawn) of the 23rd night of Ramadan, specifically emphasizing the intercession and occultation of Imam al-Mahdi (aj). It structurally combines petitions for the Imam’s presence with personal spiritual refinement, invoking Divine Names to secure certainty (*yaqin*) and forgiveness, reflecting the Shia tradition of linking cosmic order with individual salvation.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Isa, by his chain, 
(It has been narrated) from the Righteous Ones<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘You should keep repeating this supplication during the night of the 23<sup>rd</sup> Ramazan, prostrate, standing, and seating, and upon every state, and during the Month, whole of it, and howsoever it is possible for you, and whenever you are presented with your times, saying after the Praise of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Blessed and High, and the Belessings upon the Prophet<sup>saww</sup>,

Be, for You<sup>azwj</sup> Guardian, so and so (12<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>), during this time, and during every time, a Guardian, and a Protector, and a Helper, and a Proof, and a Guide, and an Aider, and a Watcher, until You<sup>azwj</sup> Settle him in Your<sup>azwj</sup> earth willingly, and Cause him<sup>asws</sup> to rejoice therein for a long time’.

And you should be saying during the seventh night, ‘O the One Who Extends the shade, and day You<sup>azwj</sup> so Desired to, You<sup>azwj</sup> would have Made it to be stationary, and Made the sun to be an evidence over it. O Knowledgeable! O Forgiver! O Eternal! O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! O Inheritor! O Resurrector of the ones who are in the graves! O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! I ask You<sup>azwj</sup> to Send Blessings upon Muhammad<sup>saww</sup> and upon the People<sup>asws</sup> of his<sup>saww</sup> Household, and Make my name to be, during this night, among the fortunate ones, and my soul to be among the martyrs, and my good deeds to be with the Illiyeen, and my sins to be Forgiven, and to Endow conviction and faith to be upon me to gladden my heart by it, and Remove the doubts from me, and my being pleased with whatever You<sup>azwj</sup> have Apportioned for me; and Grant us goodness in the world and goodness in the Hereafter, and Save us from the burning Punishment, and Grace me therein with Your<sup>azwj</sup> Remembrance, and Gratefulness to You<sup>azwj</sup>, and the hope to You<sup>azwj</sup>, and the representations, and the repentance, and the inclination to whatever Muhammad<sup>saww</sup> and the Progeny<sup>asws</sup> of Muhammad<sup>saww</sup> excelled in’.

And you should be saying during the ninth night, ‘O Coverer of the night upon the day, and the Coveror of the day upon the night! O Knowledgeable! O Wise! O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! O Lord of the lords, and Chief of the chiefs! There is no god except for You<sup>azwj</sup>! O the One Who is nearer to me than the jugular vein! O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! For You<sup>azwj</sup> are the Beautiful Names, and the Lofty examples, and the Greatness, and the Loftiness.

And you should be saying during the tenth night, ‘The Praise is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup>. There are no associates for Him<sup>azwj</sup>. The Praise is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> just as is befitting for the Benevolence of His<sup>azwj</sup> Face, and the Honour of His<sup>azwj</sup> Majesty, and just as He<sup>azwj</sup> is Rightful for it. en.sarwar: 4. Muhammad ibn ‘Isa has narrated through the chain of his narrators who has narrated the following:: “The virtuous ones, ‘Alayhim al-Salam, have said

the following that you should repeat this prayer during the twenty-third night of the month of Ramadan, while in prostration, standing, sitting and in all conditions and during the whole month if you can or whenever you remember in your lifetime. After you praise Allah, the most Blessed, the most High, and ask,

O Allah, grant salawat (favors and compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause). You should say, ‘O Allah, for the person who possesses Your authority, so and so Imam (al-Hujjah ibn al-Hassan) be in this hour and every hour, a guardian, protector, supporter, guide, leader, and helper (and an eye) until You settle him on Your earth with obedience and grant him comfort for a long time.’”

“During the fourth night, say this prayer: £ 0 the One who opens up the morning and makes the night calm and the sun and moon for calculation (of time) (I praise You). O Majestic, O all Knowing, O Generous, O Benevolent, O Powerful, O Resourceful, O Possessor of extra bounties, gifts, kingdom and honor, O Glorious and Honorable, O Allah, O Beneficent, O Allah, O the only One, O the One alone, O Allah, O Apparent, O Hidden, O Living, O Lord, no one deserves worship except You. You possess all beautiful names, exalted examples and greatness.

I appeal before You to grant salawat (favors and compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause). Please list my name in this night with the people of salvation, my spirit with the martyrs, my good deeds in Tlliyin, and forgive my wickedness. O Allah, grant me a certainty that can remain with my heart, a belief that can remove my doubts and make me to live happily with my share that You have granted to me. Grant us good in this world and in the next life, and protect us against the burning fire. Grant me the opportunity to speak of You, thank You and be interested to come to You, return to You with repentance, and grant me the opportunity with which You granted success to Muhammad and Ale (family of) Muhammad, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause.

“During the fifth night, say this prayer: ‘O the One who has made the night to serve as covering, You have made the day (for people) to make a living, the earth as a cradle and the mountains as anchors. O Allah, O Dominant, O Allah, O Compeller, O Allah, O all Hearing, O Allah, O the Nearest, O Allah, O the One who answers prayers, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, You possess all the good names, exalted examples, greatness and bounties.

I appeal before You to grant salawat (favors and compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause). Please list my name in this night with the people of salvation, my spirit with the martyrs, my good deeds in ‘Illiyin, and forgive my wickedness. O Allah, grant me a certainty that can remain with my heart, a belief that can remove my doubts and make me live happily with my share that You have granted to me. Grant us good in this world and in the next life and protect us against the burning fire. Grant me the opportunity to speak of You, thank You, be interested to come to You, return to You with repentance, and grant me the opportunity with which You granted success to Muhammad and Ale (family of) Muhammad, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause.’”

“During the sixth night say this prayer: ‘O the One who has made the night and day two signs, You are the One who has deleted the sign of night and have made the sign of day brightness so that they (creatures) may seek extra favors and pleasure. O the One who separates things with full details, O Glorious, O Benevolent, O Allah, O Generous, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, You possess all the beautiful names, exalted examples and bounties.

I appeal before You to grant salawat (favors and compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause). Please list my name in this night with the people of salvation, my spirit with the martyrs, my good deeds in ’Illiyin and my wickedness forgiven. O Allah, grant me a certainty that can remain with my heart, a belief that can remove my doubts and make me to live happily with my share that You have granted to me. Grant us good in this world and in the next life, and protect us against the burning fire. Grant me the opportunity to speak of You, thank You and be interested to come to You, return to You with repentance, and grant me the opportunity with which You granted success to Muhammad and Ale (family of) Muhammad, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause.’”

“During the seventh night say this prayer: ‘O the One who extends the shadow, had you wanted You could have made it stationary. You have made the sun to show the existence of shadow, and You then make it shrink (toward You) gradually little by little. O Generous, O Benevolent, O possessor of greatness and bounties, no one deserves worship except You. You know the unseen and seen, You are the Beneficent, the Merciful, no one except You deserves worship. O the Holy, the Peace, the Provider of sanctuary, the Dominant, the Majestic, the Compeller, the Possessor of greatness, O Allah, O Creator, the Designer, the Shape giver, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, You possess all the beautiful names, exalted examples and bounties.

I appeal before You to grant salawat (favors and compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause). Please list my name in this night with the people of salvation, my spirit with the martyrs, my good deeds in ‘Illiyin, and forgive my wickedness. O Allah, grant me a certainty that can remain with my heart, a belief that can remove my doubts and make me live happily with my share that You have granted to me. Grant us good in this world and in the next life and protect us against the burning fire. Grant me the opportunity to speak of You, thank You and be interested to come to You, return to You with repentance, and grant me the opportunity with which You granted success to Muhammad and Ale (family of) Muhammad, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause.’”

“During the eighth night say this prayer: ‘O the One who stores the night in the air and light in the sky, keeper of the sky from falling on earth, unless He wills so, and the One who keeps them from banishment. O all Knowing, O Forgiver, O the Living forever, O Allah, O the Inheritor, O the One who will resurrect people from the graves, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, You possess all the beautiful names, exalted examples and bounties.

I appeal before You to grant salawat (favors and compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause). Please list my name in this night with the people of salvation, my spirit with the martyrs, my good deeds in ‘Illiyin, and forgive my wickedness. O Allah, grant me a certainty that can remain with my heart, a belief that can remove my doubts and make me live happily with my share that You have granted to me. Grant us good in this world and in the next life, and protect us against the burning fire. Grant me the opportunity to speak of You, thank You and be interested to come to You, return to You with repentance, and grant me the opportunity with which You granted success to Muhammad and Ale (family of) Muhammad, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause.’”

“During the ninth night say this prayer: ‘O the One who covers the day with night and night with the day, O all Knowing, O all Wise, O Allah, O Lord of lords and Master of all masters, no one except You deserves worship. O the One (it is You) who is closer to me than a jugular vein. O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, You possess all the beautiful names, exalted examples and bounties.

I appeal before You to grant salawat (favors and compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause). Please list my name in this night with the people of salvation, my spirit with the martyrs, my good deeds in ‘Illiyin, and forgive my wickedness. O Allah, grant me a certainty that can remain with my heart, a belief that can remove my doubts and make me live happily with my share that You have granted to me. Grant us good in this world and in the next life, and protect us against the burning fire. Grant me the opportunity to speak of You, thank You, be interested to come to You, and return to You with repentance. Grant me the opportunity with which You granted success to Muhammad and Ale (family of) Muhammad, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause.’”

“During the tenth night say this prayer: ‘All praise belongs to Allah. He has no partners. All praise belongs to Allah because He deserves it due to the Honor of His face, the majesty of His glory and because He is worthwhile all praise. O the Holy one, You are the light of Holiness. O the One free of all defects, O the ultimate Destination of being free from all defects, O Beneficent, O the Doer of mercy, O all Knowing, O Great, O Allah, O Subtle, O Glorious, O Allah, O all Hearing, O all Seeing, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, You possess all the beautiful names, exalted examples and bounties.

I appeal before You to grant salawat (favors and compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause). Please list my name in this night with the people of salvation, my spirit with the martyrs, my good deeds in ‘Illiyin, and forgive my wickedness. O Allah, grant me a certainty that can remain with my heart, a belief that can remove my doubts and make me live happily with my share that You have granted to me. Grant us good in this world and in the next life and protect us against the burning fire. Grant me the opportunity to speak of You, thank You and be interested to come to You and return to You with repentance and grant me the opportunity with which You granted success to Muhammad and Ale (family of) Muhammad, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause.’”
